deployments_detail.use: Pingo Doce uses AI computer vision to recognize dishes automatically and speed up payment at Comida Fresca self-service restaurants (Alegro Sintra, Alverca)

SymphonyAI CINDE Connected Retail platform deployed at Pingo Doce for AI-driven merchandising and CPG collaboration — replacing static reports with real-time, prescriptive store-by-store, SKU-by-SKU insights and natural-language querying for category teams and suppliers. [SymphonyAI (CINDE Connected Retail)]

AI-powered self-checkout at Pingo Doce 'Comida Fresca' restaurants: computer-vision tills recognise meal trays by shape, colour and texture to eliminate manual food registration and cut queue times. First deployed at Alegro Sintra. [Retail Robotics Solution (computer vision)]

Store-of-the-future laboratory (Pingo Doce/Go Nova at NOVA School) using dozens of ceiling and shelf cameras with computer vision + AI for automated shelf replenishment, checkout-free shopping, backup for NFC/barcode scanning, and 24/7 self-service secure display cabinets. [OutSystems (low-code) + Truewind (delivery partner)]

AI 'sales assistant' at Biedronka self-checkouts: machine-learning produce recognition that identifies fruit/vegetables on the scale and suggests the correct product to speed weighing and checkout. Piloted across several dozen Warsaw stores. [not disclosed]
Pingo Doce AI-driven merchandising platform replacing static reports with real-time prescriptive insights for execution and supplier alignment

Biedronka mobile loyalty app ('Moja Biedronka') with AI/ML personalization: individualized offers and discounts generated from purchase history and preferences via Forcom's Recommender engine. [Future Mind (app) with Forcom Recommender (personalization engine)]
Generative-AI model tested to create personalised employee development plans (learning/career recommendations) as part of HR training and skills development. [not disclosed]

AI/ML-powered customer-service and internal-support chatbot for Biedronka: an internal chatbot supporting 80,000+ employees (2019) plus a customer-facing bot on Messenger/WhatsApp handling repetitive queries, promotions and recipe search. [KODA (usekoda.com)]
deployments_detail.value: Automates over 50% of conversations; 100,000+ users; ~6,500 conversations / 50,000 messages per month

deployments_detail.use: Migration of production data-analytics platform to Teradata VantageCloud Lake in the cloud, enabling disaster recovery and cloud-native AI capabilities for independent business units across the group. [Teradata (VantageCloud Lake)]
